messages:
incident-bot: [AUTO] SEV2 Pager triggered — service: hosted-api (/v1/generate) — symptom: high inference latency & increased 5xx rate in us-west. Pager: @sre_oncall. War room: https://warroom.redwood.dev/r/2411112222

maria.g: I'm on the war room. Seeing p95 -> 1.8s, p99 ~3.6s, and a spike in 502s. Traces point to gpu-pool-14 backlog.

devon_k: Taking owner for mitigation. Plan: 1) throttle burst traffic to fallback pool, 2) roll canary to quantized-2.1 for hot path, 3) restart stuck nodes if needed.

sre_oncall: Confirmed page received. I'll coordinate with infra for node-level checks.

ops_lead: If the rollback doesn't succeed within 10 minutes, prep to route traffic to dedicated-fallback (dedicated-1) and notify sales for customers on reserved capacity.

product_ops: Quick customer-impact note: some PLG-tier customers experiencing increased latencies and occasional 500s. No enterprise SLA breaches seen yet. We should prepare a status update and a targeted customer DM for top active API keys.

maria.g: Snapshot: kube events show repeated gRPC backpressure and 'evictionTimeout' on 3 pods in gpu-pool-14. Starting rolling restart of the deployment now.

devon_k: Running command in war room:
```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment infer-gpu --selector=pool=gpu-pool-14
```
I'll also start canary to quantized-2.1 on 10% traffic.

support_eng: I'll assemble a list of top-10 active API keys and send a heads-up DM to owners. Drafting customer DM below — please review.

maria.g: Status page draft (post once we confirm impact and mitigation):
```
[Status] Investigating — High inference latency impacting hosted API (us-west)
- Start: 2024-11-06 13:07 UTC
- Impact: Increased latency and elevated 5xx for a subset of API requests to /v1/generate.
- Customer impact: Intermittent slow responses, limited errors for PLG customers.
- Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have mitigation progress.
```

product_ops: Good. Approve posting. Add link to war room and incident id INC-2411112222 in the update.

devon_k: Mitigation status: rolled restart completed for 2/3 affected pods, canary quantized-2.1 serving at 12% and latency for canary requests down ~40%. Continuing.

sre_oncall: Confirming paging to backup @ops_lead for the 10:30 handoff window.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2411112222 — SEV2 — channel #incidents auto-notified.

support_eng: Customer DM draft for top-10 keys: 
```
Hi — we noticed increased latency for API requests to /v1/generate in us-west starting ~13:07 UTC. We're actively investigating and have mitigation in progress. If you're seeing timeouts, try retrying once after 5s. We'll update you within 15 minutes and share a postmortem when available. — Redwood Inference Support
```

ops_lead: Please tag postmortem owner. I volunteer to own the postmortem write-up unless someone else prefers.

maria.g: Handoff summary for next on-call (to paste in ops handoff):
- Incident: INC-2411112222
- Owner: devon_k (mitigation) + maria.g (coordination)
- Current state: mitigation in progress, latency trending down after restarts & canary, monitoring for 30m
- Actions to take on handover: continue monitoring graphs (p99, error-rate), confirm no regression in other regions, escalate to infra if any pod reappears with 'evictionTimeout'

devon_k: Metrics stable for 8m, p99 decreased to ~1.1s. I'll keep the canary at 12% for 20 more minutes and then iterate to 30% if stable.

product_ops: Posting status update now to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2411112222 and sending DM to affected customers.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2411112420 — check for rollback status and handoff notes.

maria.g: Closing loop for initial kickoff: mitigation owner assigned, paging confirmed, status page and customer DM drafted & posted, war room active. Leaving war room open for monitoring and handoff to @ops_lead at 10:30.

devon_k: Thanks all — will follow up with a brief timeline and suspected root cause (autoscaler/backpressure interplay) in the postmortem.

support_eng: I'll follow up with customers individually if they reply.

ops_lead: I'll take handoff at 10:30. Please add any extra notes to the war room pad.

maria.g: Marking thread 'monitoring' — will update if anything regresses.
